capabilities.title: Generate & edit
capabilities.description: Images, video, speech and music, as assets or inside an app.

capabilities.title: Creative workflows
capabilities.description: Style exploration, reusable references and visual storytelling.

capabilities.title: Live apps
capabilities.description: Generation interfaces and tools connected to a Space.

capabilities.title: Publish & share

capabilities.title: Work with Spaces

works.title: Hogwarts Tower Lofi
works.creator: ATou
works.summary: A pixel-art Hogwarts retreat with changing scenes, house common rooms, weather, music and small discoveries.
demonstrates: Combine procedural visuals, ambient sound and interaction into a persistent browser experience.
Publish a world with multiple scenes rather than a single generated image.
works.access: Public browser experience. Personal settings and shareable links have their own local-state behavior.
works.cost: No paid generation was performed; viewing existing scenes is distinct from recreating the work.
works.reuse: Unofficial, non-commercial fan work. No source or asset reuse license verified.
works.verification: Public Cohub page and controls viewed. Enrollment, letters and media export were not fully audited.

works.title: Cohub Fusion Lab
works.creator: ATou
works.summary: An image-fusion workspace where two visual ideas become the starting point for another creation.
demonstrates: Make a generation workflow visual through selectable and draggable reference cards.
Connect a focused creative interface to the user's chosen Cohub Space.
works.access: Public example interface. Fusion asks the user to select a Cohub Space and grant the required access.
works.cost: Fusion can incur model charges; the displayed estimate is not a current price guarantee.
works.reuse: Reference only. No reuse or remix license verified.
works.verification: Public interface and existing example cards rendered. No fusion submitted and no Space authorized.

works.title: Atelier Dressmaker
works.creator: ATou
works.summary: A dressmaking workspace with a rendered gown, fabric choices and controls for its individual parts.
demonstrates: Turn a creative idea into an interactive browser tool, not just a reference image.
Publish a visual editor with an inspectable rendered object.
works.access: The public editor opens without connecting a Cohub account; the interface marks its work as session-only.
works.cost: No model-generation or payment action was performed.
works.reuse: Reference only. No source or asset reuse license verified.
works.verification: Rendered gown, materials and editing controls viewed. Full design, export and persistence workflows were not tested.

works.title: Cohub Architecture Atlas
works.creator: ATou
works.summary: A published guide to Cohub's architecture, prompt journey and local execution flow, grounded in repository evidence.
demonstrates: Turn project documentation and code evidence into a browsable technical reference.
Package architecture, sequences and workflows as linked visual explanations.
works.access: Public reference index. It is a dated analysis, not a live view into another user's workspace.
works.cost: No model call or privileged workspace operation was performed.
works.reuse: Reference only. Verify current platform contracts before copying commands or implementation details.
works.verification: Public index and its three diagram entries rendered. Historical architecture claims were not re-audited.

works.title: Book Lens
works.creator: ATou
works.summary: A photo-to-interaction tool with optional book recognition, manual annotation and downloadable web projects.
demonstrates: Combine AI visual analysis with an editable interface instead of returning text alone.
Offer a manual path when the user does not want to send an image to a model.
works.access: Public interface and existing example. Automatic recognition requires login and authorization and sends the photo to a model.
works.cost: Automatic recognition uses the user's Cohub credits. No recognition was run in this check.
works.reuse: Reference only. Projects are described as browser-local until downloaded; no cross-device storage guarantee.
works.verification: Public page, built-in example entry and manual/automatic choices viewed. No private photo uploaded or export workflow tested.

works.title: One More Stop
works.creator: ATou
works.summary: An AI music release presented as a sound letter, with two versions, lyrics and downloadable tracks.
demonstrates: Present generated audio as a finished release with its own visual identity.
Keep alternate versions and supporting text together in a shareable work.
works.access: Public page with existing audio players and download links; not a live music generator.
works.cost: No new track was generated. The original production cost was not verified.
works.reuse: Listening and download links do not establish reuse or licensing rights.
works.verification: Release page, two players and track durations rendered. No new generation or download was performed.

works.title: Sugar Stall
works.creator: ATou
works.summary: A warm, illustrated sugar-painting stall with a selection wheel and a hands-on drawing surface.
demonstrates: Combine finished visual assets and canvas interaction in a small browser experience.
Publish a tactile creative toy rather than a static illustration.
works.access: Public canvas experience; no login was required to open the scene.
works.cost: No model generation or paid operation was performed.
works.reuse: Reference only. No source or artwork reuse license verified.
works.verification: Canvas, wheel and drawing surface visibly rendered. A complete painting session was not audited.

works.title: Photo Words
works.creator: ATou
works.summary: A photo-based vocabulary tool with language selection, image analysis and a history view.
demonstrates: Turn an image-understanding workflow into a focused learning interface.
Combine capture, analysis and saved results instead of a one-off prompt.
works.access: The public starting interface is accessible; review its upload, history and authorization behavior before providing personal photos.
works.cost: AI analysis can use backend services. Billing and analysis were not exercised.
works.reuse: Reference only. No reuse license or cross-device history guarantee verified.
works.verification: Language selector, capture/upload controls and history entry viewed. No camera permission, photo upload or analysis submitted.

works.title: Cohub: Decisions Over Time
works.creator: ATou
works.summary: An evidence-linked timeline connecting Cohub's project changes, key decisions and selected public conversations.
demonstrates: Transform a project's history into a navigable narrative with source references.
Present decisions and their evidence together, rather than only a final summary.
works.access: Public analysis snapshot. Linked original contexts may have different access requirements.
works.cost: No new analysis or model call was submitted.
works.reuse: Historical reference only; quoted commands and behavior are not current API guarantees.
works.verification: Timeline, evidence sections and dated source excerpts rendered. Original conversations were not reopened or re-audited.

works.title: Twenty Song Sessions
works.creator: ATou
works.summary: A collection of AI-produced songs across languages and genres, with main and alternate versions side by side.
demonstrates: Publish a multi-track creative collection with consistent browsing and listening controls.
Expose alternate generated takes for comparison rather than discarding them.
works.access: Public players for existing tracks. The page does not provide live generation.
works.cost: No new music was generated; the original production cost was not verified.
works.reuse: Reference listening only. No commercial or remix license verified.
works.verification: Playlist layout rendered and the first audio track loaded metadata successfully. The full playlist was not audited.

works.title: The Compliment Lab
works.creator: ATou
works.summary: A playful, single-purpose AI writing interface that turns a subject into an unusually specific compliment.
demonstrates: Give an Agent-backed text workflow a focused interface and a clear outcome.
Use a small creative constraint to make interaction different from an open chat box.
works.access: Public input screen. Running the writing workflow can invoke backend research and model services.
works.cost: The execution and billing path was not tested; do not assume generated responses are free.
works.reuse: Reference only. No reuse or remix license verified.
works.verification: Input, suggested subjects and action control viewed. No subject submitted and no response generated.

works.title: Three-Minute Inspiration
works.creator: ATou
works.summary: A small creative exercise deck that makes starting a writing or drawing session feel approachable.
demonstrates: Package a reusable creative prompt collection as an interactive object.
Use a static, low-friction experience when live AI is not necessary.
works.access: Public, no login. The deck explicitly selects from six preset exercises rather than generating new prompts.
works.cost: No model call is involved in changing the preset card.
works.reuse: Reference only. The page does not automatically save an exercise history; download is a separate user action.
works.verification: The change-card control was clicked and displayed a different preset. Download was not exercised.

works.title: Skribline
works.creator: ATou
works.summary: A drawing-led browser game with different routes, selectable characters and a limited-ink mechanic.
demonstrates: Turn a concrete interaction mechanic into a shareable browser game.
Combine character choices, input controls and designed progression in a published App.
works.access: The public selection screen opens without a Cohub login.
works.cost: No paid generation or payment action was performed.
works.reuse: The page credits the original game by mzkrol. No source, artwork or remix license verified.
works.verification: Route and character selection screen rendered. Complete gameplay and score export were not audited.

works.title: Aurora Ski Loop
works.creator: ATou
works.summary: A published 30-second night-skiing video loop under an aurora, presented in a minimal media player.
demonstrates: Turn a generated visual sequence into a finished, shareable moving-image work.
Deliver media directly rather than requiring a new application around every result.
works.access: Public player for a pre-rendered video, not an on-demand generator.
works.cost: No new generation was run; the original production cost was not verified.
works.reuse: Reference only. No source or media reuse license verified.
works.verification: A real decoded video frame and the 30-second player rendered. Loop continuity and the production pipeline were not re-audited.

works.title: Number Gummies
works.creator: ATou
works.summary: A visual arithmetic toy with number pieces, small goals and a sequence of counting and combination exercises.
demonstrates: Make an abstract concept tangible through an interactive browser scene.
Publish a focused learning toy with progressive exercises and direct manipulation.
works.access: Public canvas experience; no Cohub login was needed to view the first exercise.
works.cost: No paid model call or purchase was performed.
works.reuse: Reference only. No educational outcome, source or asset license is implied.
works.verification: The first exercise, number pieces and level selector rendered. All exercises and learning outcomes were not evaluated.

works.title: Space Transit Map
works.creator: ATou
works.summary: A Space's creation history becomes a transit map, with published apps as interchanges.
demonstrates: Turn public Space activity into a custom visual experience.
Connect a published app to a separately maintained data snapshot.
works.access: Public read-only preview. The map uses the author's published activity snapshot, not your private Space.
works.cost: No paid action was performed during preview verification.
works.reuse: Reference only. Installing a version in another Space is a separate action with its own data and publication scope.
works.verification: Public map, labels and activity snapshot rendered. No installation, hooks or data collection started.

works.title: Relativity
works.creator: tzwm
works.summary: A visual explanation of relativity, published directly as a native Cohub Board.
demonstrates: Publish a native Board rather than wrapping every result in a new website.
Use a spatial canvas for a visual explanation.
works.access: Public Board viewer. No Space authorization was needed to view it.
works.cost: No generation or other paid action was performed.
works.reuse: Reference only. No reuse or remix license verified.
works.verification: Public Board rendered in the browser. Editing and any animation workflow were not exercised.

works.title: Twenty Visual Directions
works.creator: tzwm
works.summary: A side-by-side study of two image models across twenty art directions, using the same references.
demonstrates: Compare generated variations instead of choosing from a single result.
Keep references and prompts consistent across a style study.
works.access: Public gallery of already generated images.
works.cost: Historical results and prices are not a current model or pricing guarantee.
works.reuse: Reference only. Images include third-party references; no reuse license verified.
works.verification: Public comparison page and image grid rendered. The original generation runs were not repeated.

works.title: Darkroom
works.creator: tzwm
works.summary: An image-generation studio with model selection, visual directions and a comparison sheet.
demonstrates: Bring image generation into a purpose-built app.
Keep prompts, models and visual directions in one interface.
works.access: The interface opens publicly. Generating can require sign-in and generation authorization.
works.cost: Generation may consume credits; check the selected model before running.
works.reuse: Reference only. No reuse or remix license verified.
works.verification: Public interface and controls viewed anonymously. No images generated; the preview shows its real empty state.

works.title: Not One Word Lost
works.creator: tzwm
works.summary: A short film about building Cohub, with the finished video, storyboard and making-of linked together.
demonstrates: Bring research, narrative and finished media into one published work.
Keep production references alongside the result.
works.access: Public video page. Linked production context can have a different access scope.
works.cost: Previewing the existing film does not reproduce its production process or establish production cost.
works.reuse: Reference only. No reuse or remix license verified.
works.verification: Public page and a decoded video frame viewed. No production or paid generation performed.

works.title: Desktop
works.creator: Kinori
works.summary: A shared desktop for arranging a Space's apps while keeping each app's authorization separate.
demonstrates: Compose existing Space apps rather than rebuilding every tool.
Make Space selection an explicit part of a connected app.
works.access: Choose a Space and grant the requested access to use the connected desktop. Child apps retain their own authorization.
works.cost: Connected apps can have their own costs. None were invoked during verification.
works.reuse: Reference only. No reuse or remix license verified.
works.verification: Public connection screen viewed. No Space connected; the shared layout was not tested.
